sections.title: Where to Find the Ceramic Chevaliere
How to Beat the Ceramic Chevaliere
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Dark, Light is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.
